title: Oscar and the House
author: Edmund Hartwell
blurb: Jonah Okonkwo, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
